## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `004a1decf57e26c16dd980821f0bbc4c86ea2d70`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #33419 (body, the `domain:ui#2` claim, the os-dev-report), PR #33538 (body, 15-file list), the net diff `origin/main...004a1dec` (15 files, +154 −3), and the 41 check-runs on the head. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/i18n` published type: right, a widening.** One key, `chatbot.plan.suggestedFieldLegend`, is added under `chatbot.plan` in all eleven packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant), one line each. The entry exports `en`, and `TranslationKeys = typeof en`, so both gain one member. No key is removed, renamed or reworded, and `chatbot.plan.suggestedField` is unchanged. Locale packs are plain objects, not annotated against `TranslationKeys`, so the added key does not narrow anything inside the repo. Earlier `@object-ui/i18n` key additions in the changelogs (`oauth.consent.scope.*`, `console.settingsHub.adminManaged*`, `console.studio.accessRequired`) were declared the same way: widening, patch.
- **Interpolation contract: right.** Every pack keeps the `{{mark}}` placeholder spelled exactly. The component passes `mark: suggestedMark`, which is the same `t('chatbot.plan.suggestedField')` value the chip shows, so the legend always quotes the chip's own word. The `defaultValue` is the en sentence, so it behaves the same as the pack when no pack is loaded.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` public surface: unchanged.** `PlanCardObjectRows` is module-private: nothing outside `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` imports it, and it has one call site, at ~L4334. Its props are unchanged. The one new DOM hook, `data-testid="proposed-plan-suggested-legend"`, is read only by the new test. `anySuggested` comes from `objects[].fields[].suggested`, which is already on the wire, and nothing in the diff reads any other field.
- **Accept-sets: none touched.** No `packages/spec`, Zod schema, server, producer or metadata path is in the diff. The card's ⛔ "No producer change" holds. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.
- **Card acceptance: met.** (a) When any field is suggested, one legend line is drawn after the object rows, saying the AI added the field and the user did not ask for it. It comes from the i18n pack in every shipped locale. (b) The machine name is still reachable: the chip keeps `title={f.name}`, and the test checks the titles `['title','category']`. (c) The pin: one named field plus one suggested field gives exactly one legend, and only the suggested chip carries `data-suggested`. The CONTROL, with no suggested field, gives no legend and no 「补充」 anywhere in the block. The dev ran the pin red on base (3 fail | 1 pass), and an ablation that forces the condition true turns only the CONTROL red. That is the pin's own evidence, recorded on the card and not re-run here.
- **Check-runs on the head (41): none failed.** These completed `success`: Check Changeset (one of its two runs), Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Type Check · workspace, Type Check · debt ledger, Test Core, Plan Test UI shards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label, filter. The skipped ones are opt-in, schedule-gated or matrix placeholders. These were still `in_progress` when read, with no conclusion: Build UI Deps, the second Check Changeset run, Lint (ESLint; PM dispatch-gates; docs & code guards; repo & tooling gates; CI, release & engine gates; scoped query-options erasure; scoped slot lookup & corpus; scoped tooling self-tests), Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · source gates, and Live E2E UI. No UI test shard had a check-run on the head yet. This verdict is on the contract. Landing still waits for those runs to finish green; the queue enforces that, and this record does not.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/33419-plan-card-suggested-legend.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-chatbot': patch`, `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`. These are the two packages the diff moves, and both publish `dist` (version 18.4.0), so a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong. None was used.
- The rule is AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3. With `Metadata-protocol: none`, the level is `patch`. A non-protocol widening also ships `patch`. Both packages are declared `patch`, which is **right**.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` appears line-initial in the PR body, in the changeset body and on the claim, together with `Metadata-protocol: none`. The arm comes from the closed pair, and the line is not `no (widening)`. It matches the diff: one added published key, nothing removed or narrowed. **Right.** There is no BREAKING banner and no ADR-0087 marker, and none is owed for a widening.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag: `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`, census 118 → 119, a file the claim does not name. ACCEPTED.** The change is forced and bounded. The de value quotes `„{{mark}}“`, which is exactly one more correctly paired span, and this census pins the pair count as a literal. Both literals move by exactly one: `okSpans` 118 → 119, and `{open, close, rdq}` 118/118/0 → 119/119/0. Each move has a dated comment naming #33419 and the key, the same way every earlier pair was added. The durable identity `close === open + rdq` is unchanged, so no assertion was weakened. The file is in the same package as the claimed locale files, so this is the claim's "one added key" showing up in that key's own package census, not a surface creep. No other literal-count census under `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` is affected.
- **Dev deviation: PR #33333 was read only through the card's quote. ACCEPTED.** The card is the input of record, and it quotes the measurement it relies on.
- **Dev deviation: no labels were sent on `pr_create`. ACCEPTED.** The order names no labels. The labels now on the PR (`documentation`, `size/m`, `tests`, `tooling`, `needs:contract-review`) were added by automation, not by the dev.
- **`open_questions`: `[]`.** There are none to answer. `out_of_scope_findings: []`, `security_findings: none`.
- **The optional tooltip sentence: answered.** The card offered a legend line OR a chip tooltip sentence. The dev chose the legend and left `title={f.name}` alone, which satisfies "the machine name stays reachable". This is within the card's choice and is not a gap.
- **The other `title={f.name}` site (~L4363): out of scope, correctly.** It is the phase-1 blueprint fallback chip, and that path never carries `suggested`.

Findings:
- must-fix: none.
- should-fix: none.
- nit: the changeset says "the `@object-ui/i18n` packs gain the key". Earlier entries also said that the exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` gain one member, which lets an upgrader who greps the type find the entry. This is wording only.
- nit: the PR body says "The ruling allowed the same sentence on the chip tooltip too". There is no ruling comment on #33419; the option comes from the card's Acceptance. This is prose only.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Verdict: **ACCEPT** · head `004a1dec` · 2026-11-15T00:19Z

1. **Shape.** Draft → `main`, `Fixes #33419`. 15 files, +154/−3:
   - `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` (`PlanCardObjectRows`: one legend line when any field is suggested)
   - a new rendered test, `ChatbotEnhanced.planCardSuggestedLegend-33419.test.tsx`
   - one key, `chatbot.plan.suggestedFieldLegend`, in all eleven `@object-ui/i18n` packs
   - the `de` quote-pairing census 118 → 119 (`de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`), forced by the new `de` value's one quote pair
   - one root changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch)

   On the claimed surface (6885550647), plus the census file, accepted below.
2. **Premise.** Re-measured by the dev on `f068cde8`: nothing on the plan card explained 「· 补充」, and the chip's tooltip is the machine name (3 legend pins red on base).
   - **The fix:** when at least one field on the card is suggested, one line under the field rows says the AI added those fields and the user did not ask for them, quoting the chip's own word through `{{mark}}`. The chip keeps `title` = machine name. ⛔ No producer change.
   - **Pins:** one named + one suggested field → exactly one legend; CONTROL no suggested field → no legend. Ablation of the condition: the CONTROL red.
3. **Contract record.** PASS 6886276580 on this head (`TIER_DEFAULT`): one additive i18n key, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch` right.
4. **Gates on head `004a1dec`.** All 66 check runs are `success` or `skipped`. The dev's local `--ran` is 38/38, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
5. **Accepted deviation and nits.**
   - The census bump touches a file the claim did not name; it is the added key's own package census, both counts move by exactly one with a dated comment, and no assertion is weakened.
   - Nits from the record (no change asked): the changeset could also say the exported `en` / `TranslationKeys` gain one member; the PR body calls the card's tooltip option a "ruling".
6. **K.** 4 first-parent commits since base `f068cde8` < 15: no base sync. **Path face:** not governed; 157 changed lines.
7. **Out of scope.** None.
8. **Authority.** Landing under the maintainer's standing authorisation 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」 (2026-10-25T11:35Z).
